claim_boundary.scope: Declared observed operations journey with independent native wait/rollback evidence

goal: Create a customer/location, stocked product/price, opening inventory and order. Complete two shipments for quantities 1 then 2, followed by ONE aggregate invoice for quantity 3 and payment of its observed grand total. Post invoice, payment and allocations using the application APIs without reposting already-posted documents. Create a quantity-1 credit memo against that invoice, complete and post it, then Reverse_Correct it through the workflow and read the reversal and accounting. Inject an exception after saving a draft customer in a separate transaction; explicitly roll it back, retry once with logical key LY-BOUNDARY-RETRY, then repeat lookup to prove caller-keyed idempotency. With two overlapping transactions, use Query.setForUpdate(true).list() on exactly one customer primary key, increment the credit limit by 0.01 in each, coordinate with latches and record the lock wait and readbacks. Use application models/workflows for business writes, never SQL substitutes. Independently captured final rows and the frozen private judge determine the outcome.
title: Generate an operations journey under a frozen comparison contract
